rr.xi.rival.same: Your own club — a different eleven
rr.xi.general: Positions are the archive's four broad ones (goalkeeper, defence, midfield, attack). Where a man stands in the shape is an estimate, not a record.
rr.xi.notReady: This club cannot host an eleven in {formation}: {reason}.
rr.xi.noRival: No club can field a rival in this shape yet.
rr.xi.tooDear: Not enough left: you would not be able to fill the rest.
rr.xi.changeShape: Changing the shape deals a new round.
rr.mc.calm: The ball is moving around the middle.
rr.mc.xgNote: xG is a game estimate of how good each chance was — not a record.
rr.mc.build.long.1: A long ball from {a}; {b} brings it down.
rr.mc.build.cross.0: {a} whips it in from the flank — {b} is there!
rr.mc.build.cross.2: {a} gets to the byline and pulls it back for {b}.
rr.mc.build.switch.1: A diagonal from {a} finds {b} on the far side.
rr.mc.build.back.0: {a} knocks it back to {b} to reset.
rr.mc.build.dribble.1: {a} drops a shoulder and goes past.
rr.mc.end.post.1: It cannons off the woodwork — {name} cannot believe it.
rr.mc.end.tackle.0: {by} steps in and takes it cleanly.
rr.mc.end.intercept.0: {by} reads it and cuts it out.
rr.mc.end.intercept.2: {by} is first to the loose ball.
rr.mc.end.corner.0: It goes behind for a corner.
rr.mc.end.offside.1: The flag goes up — {name} was a yard ahead.
rr.mc.end.foul.1: A foul by {by}; the referee blows.
rr.mc.end.card.0: {by} goes into the book for stopping {name}.
rr.mc.end.card.2: The referee has seen enough — {by} is booked.
rr.xi.rule1: Every card costs €1M to €5M, in half-million steps. Your eleven must fit €35M.
rr.xi.rule2: Fill the shape: a keeper, then each line. Tap a slot on the pitch to go back to it.
rr.xi.rule3: A card that would leave you unable to fill the rest is faded and cannot be picked.
rr.xi.rule4: One shuffle, and only before the first pick.
rr.xi.rule5: Your rival is an eleven from the club you chose, fixed before your first pick. The match is played from the lines — attack, midfield, defence — not added up.
rr.xi.o.invalid: That eleven could not be checked. Deal a new board and try again.
